scripts.ensure:test-db: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('prisma', { recursive: true }); fs.closeSync(fs.openSync('prisma/test.db', 'a'));"
scripts.db:push:test: pnpm ensure:test-db && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push
scripts.seed: pnpm build && node -e "require('./dist/seed.js').seed().then(() => process.exit(0)).catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.seed:test: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db pnpm build && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node -e "require('./dist/seed.js').seed().then(() => process.exit(0)).catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.studio:test: pnpm ensure:test-db && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma studio
